title: Stale 10-minute cache without a Whop API key expires every member (reasoned from code, not run: cannot wait 10 min)
persona: Trial user, day 7 (QA-PAYWALL, signed webhooks + forged sl_session cookie)
steps: Read lib/auth.ts memberStatus and lib/whop.ts checkAccess
With no WHOP_API_KEY, checkAccess returns false (not null) so checked_at older than 10 min takes the active=false path
expected: Webhook-driven state should keep working (or the app should fall back to last known state) when the access API is unavailable.
actual: Code path: trialing/active/past_due -> status "expired" ten minutes after the last webhook/check, so paid members would lose access; trial_used also loses its marker. With a real key the Whop answer decides, and a Whop outage (throws) falls back to last status (good). In prod, a missing/misconfigured WHOP_API_KEY would lock everyone out 10 min after their last event. Also memberStatus can flip a trial_used user back to active when Whop reports access. Unverified live.
suspected_area: lib/whop.ts checkAccess returns false instead of null when key/product missing
